messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "10 to 15 mg/kg/day given in 3 divided doses for patients 3 to 11 years of age"
set: ["10 to 15 mg/kg/day given in 3 divided doses for patients 3 to 11 years of age", "40 mg/kg/day for patients 3 to 4 years of age", "25 to 35 mg/kg/day for patients 5 to 11 years of age", "4 mg oral dose for patients aged 4 to 11 years", "10 mg orally per day in divided doses", "450 mg/day in up to 4 divided doses", "300 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older", "600 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older", "2000 mg/day in divided doses", "5 to 60 mg per day in divided doses", "up to 2 or 3 weeks for muscle spasm", "1 spray in each nostril once daily for children 2 to 11 years", "1 spray in each nostril once daily for children 4 to 11 years", "5 mg orally per day in divided doses for narcolepsy", "3 mg once daily", "children with heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia: 5 mg to 20 mg once daily for those 10 years of age and older"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
